info.description: This course provides a comprehensive overview of procurement and supply chain management activities in an international context. Through thematic modules, learners will gain knowledge of global procurement risks, the organizational structures of procurement in multinational corporations, global procurement operations, and the application of information systems in procurement management. The course also explores supplier selection and evaluation strategies, strategic cost management, supply chain analysis techniques, and negotiation and conflict management skills. Additionally, it helps learners understand how to build and maintain global strategic alliances with suppliers to optimize competitive advantage. Moreover, in response to the rapid digital transformation in the industry, the course places a special emphasis on integrating in-depth knowledge of modern technologies applied in practical procurement management. With a strong focus on both theory and practice, this course serves as a solid foundation for developing decision-making and supply chain management capabilities—particularly in formulating effective procurement strategies in the context of globalization.

clos.loDetails: Understand and analyze the various risks associated with global purchasing, including business, price, quality, and contract risks, as well as cultural and operational challenges.
Evaluate the organizational structures and roles of purchasing functions within multinational corporations, and assess trends in purchasing organization and cross-functional collaboration.
Implement effective global procurement operations by applying key success factors, strategic processes, and benchmarking practices to enhance value creation.
Analyze the impact of information technology on procurement management, including data encapsulation, vendor management, and electronic data interchange (EDI) processes.

Develop capabilities in supplier management through the establishment of supplier intelligence, evaluation techniques, and strategic sourcing methods to optimize supplier relationships and apply analytical tools for purchasing decisions.
Apply negotiation techniques and conflict management strategies in global purchasing scenarios while utilizing cost management tools and developing strategic alliances for competitive advantage
Show professionalism, ethical behavior, and social responsibility while collaborating effectively on group projects.

assessments.questionType:
OP1: The class should be divided into 4 to 6 groups. Each group will select a company or corporation engaged in global procurement and conduct an in-depth analysis of its global procurement management practices or specific activities related to the execution of its global purchasing / procurement process. The analysis should include: Company Overview and Industry Context; Global Procurement Strategy and Structure; Global Supplier Selection and Management; Risk Management in Global Procurement; Logistics and Operational Support; Performance Evaluation and Recommendations.
